shortDescription: The UK government said it will introduce a new loan program to help first-time buyers purchase new-build homes, according to Bloomberg.Prime Minister Andy Burnham is seeking to spur housing construction and help more people buy property.

title: UK Plans Loan Program for First-Time Buyers of New-Build Homes
